account: Direct inspection confirms the posterior: exactly two questions are unanswered — D10 (the memorandum) and question:raised:529a9c7e8677:rq-d5-stronger, which is a self-labeled conjecture whose own raising answer (answer:work:006-lower-bound-v5-compact) pins down the exact missing lemma (positive-density two-child branching with average log-growth slope below 3) and explains why the worst-case child max <= 4d^3 estimate caps the proved lower bound at Theta(log H).
